question: Oliver Kell's exhaustion-extension idea applied to the very short term: on four_pct days, expect higher trailing 1-week return (ret7, more overextended in the last week) to be WORSE (lower avg stop-R) than a lower/flatter ret7 — a short-term fade risk.
plain: Oliver Kell warns that a stock already up a lot in just the past week is more likely to be exhausted; this checks if 4%-up days following a big 1-week run do worse than ones without that run-up.
